extras: No telemetry, no accounts, no ads.
intentEvidence: Link Canvas cards and notes straight to a line of source code.
motivation: Built for documenting a game or any code base that lives next to your vault.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of linking documentation or Canvas notes directly to specific lines within external or internal source code files.
summary: Allows linking Canvas cards and notes directly to specific lines of source code using relative paths and various editor URIs.
